summary.scope: Completed paired 100-question validation, M5/S0 versus v5 S10. Diagnosis only.
summary.outcomes: S0 64 and S10 59 correct. S10 corrected 3 and harmed 8. All 5 net losses were on Rad-ReStruct.
summary.shared_failure: All 58 S10 ROI crop calls failed on the missing deployment environment variable. The independent S0 arm had 37 successful calls and one invalid box. On five different Rad-ReStruct cases, S10 saw a crop failure and Verify approved the wrong negative answer. A separate wrong positive was also approved under crop failure.
summary.counterexample: On a separate image, Verify contradicted a proposed negative answer using image-grounded evidence and S10 answered correctly.
summary.development_link: A developer candidate had already identified the crop KeyError, but its accepted semantic patch only revised answer-prompt wording. The deterministic tool deployment defect has its own shared environment repair.
summary.revision_question: How should the improver distinguish unavailable tools, inapplicable tools, disagreements between valid observations, and verifier claims that contribute independent evidence, before selecting a concrete P change? Focus on one transferable role change. Treat the earlier score difference as diagnostic context, since software and environment differed between these arms.
